establishes: OpenAI trains its models to align to the Model Spec's principles; the public Model Spec, while it may not include every detail, is fully consistent with intended model behavior; and production models do not yet fully reflect the Model Spec but OpenAI is continually refining its systems toward closer alignment with it.

The Model Spec is one part of OpenAI's broader strategy for building and deploying AI responsibly, complemented by separate usage policies (governing use of the API and ChatGPT) and separate safety protocols (testing, monitoring, and mitigating safety issues).

OpenAI publishes the Model Spec to increase transparency around how it shapes model behavior and to invite public discussion on how to improve it; the spec will be continuously updated based on feedback and lessons from serving users; and it is dedicated to the public domain under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 deed.

The overview (the document's opening section) sets out the goals, trade-offs, and governance approach that guide model behavior; it is aimed primarily at human readers but also gives useful context to the model.

The rest of the document (beyond the overview) consists of direct instructions to the model, in this order: foundational definitions used throughout the document, then a description of the chain of command governing how the model prioritizes and reconciles multiple instructions, then sections covering specific principles guiding the model's behavior. The ordering is carried by the sequence in which these are described.
